```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r raw-datasets, message=FALSE}
## loading in raw data
covariate_data <- read_csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
gene_exp_data <- read_csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
linker_names <- read_csv("~/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

# glimpse(covariate_data)
```


```{r colour-palette}
## setting project colours
base_colour <- "#3E7C8C"
colour1 <- "#D4849F"
```


```{r covariate-cleaning}
## fixing variables of interest 
## removing the text from gestational age at time of collection
clean_cov_data <- covariate_data %>%
  mutate(sampleCollection_gestAge_wks = parse_number(sampleCollection_gestAge_wks))

## check that it worked
# class(clean_cov_data$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks)
# summary(clean_cov_data$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks)
# sum(is.na(clean_cov_data$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks))

## removing text on pregnancy condition
# table(clean_cov_data$preg_preeclampsia)
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(preg_preeclampsia = str_remove(preg_preeclampsia, "pregnancy_condition: "),
         preg_preeclampsia = factor(preg_preeclampsia,
                                    levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia")))
# table(clean_cov_data$preg_preeclampsia)

## changing mat BMI to categorical
## taking out the text
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(mat_BMI=as.numeric(str_remove(mat_BMI, "bmi_kg/m2: ")))

## check 
# class(clean_cov_data$mat_BMI)
# summary(clean_cov_data$mat_BMI)          
# sum(is.na(clean_cov_data$mat_BMI))       

## splitting BMI into WHO categories
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(bmi_group = cut(mat_BMI,
                         breaks = c(0, 18.5, 25, 30, 65),
                         labels = c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese"),
                         right  = FALSE))
# table(clean_cov_data$bmi_group)

## underweight only has 5 so I'll group it with normal
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(bmi_group = cut(mat_BMI,
                         breaks = c(0, 25, 30, Inf), # inf to catch anything after 30
                         labels = c("Underweight/Normal", "Overweight", "Obese"),
                         right  = FALSE))
# table(clean_cov_data$bmi_group)
```


```{r gene-exp-cleaning}
## fixing the probeID column in the gene expression dataset
clean_gene_exp <- gene_exp_data %>%
  rename(probe_id = 1)

# head(clean_gene_exp)
```

```{r gene-histogram}
## histogram of bard1 gene - 8058695
bard1 <- clean_gene_exp %>%
  filter(probe_id == 8058695) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe_id,
               names_to = "geoID",
               values_to = "expression")

# head(bard1)
# summary(bard1)

ggplot(bard1, aes(x = expression)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = base_colour, color = "white") +
  labs(title = "BARD1 Gene Expression",
       x = "Expression Level",
       y = "Number of samples")+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title= element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid= element_blank(),
        axis.line= element_line(color = "black"))
```

```{r scatterplot-gene-cont-variable}
## joining the gene to the cov.data using shared geo_ID
bard1_cov <- bard1 %>%
  left_join(clean_cov_data, by = "geoID") 

## checks
# nrow(bard1_cov) - ensuring no rows lost in the join                                       
# sum(is.na(bard1_cov$sampleCollection_gestAge_wks))     

## scatterplot

  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2, color = base_colour) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = colour1, fill = colour1, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "BARD1 Expression vs. Gestational Age at Sample Collection",
       x = "Gestational Age at Sample Collection (weeks)",

   theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))
```


```{r boxplot-of-both}
## boxplot of both categorical variables
# defining palette
col_palette <- c("Normal" = base_colour, "Preeclampsia" = colour1)
  

ggplot(bard1_cov, aes(x = bmi_group, y = expression, fill = preg_preeclampsia)) +

```

```{r}
## SUBMISSION 2 - pieces of function 
## creating the list of genes
project_genes <- c("BARD1","ISM2", "ZPBP")

## subset to genes of interest to get probe ID
gene_list<- linker_names%>%
  filter(GENE %in% project_genes)

gene_list

## pulling the probe IDs using code 
gene <- "ISM2"
probe <- gene_list %>% 
  filter(GENE == gene) %>% 
  pull(PROBEID)

probe

expression_values <- clean_gene_exp %>%
  filter(probe_id == probe) %>%
  select(-probe_id) %>% # choosing all samples except the probe ID 
  unlist() # turns the row into a plain list of numbers so I can look them up by sample ID

gene_and_cov <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(expression = expression_values[geoID]) # finally matching each woman's ID to the expression values

```

```{r}
col_palette <- c("Normal" = base_colour, "Preeclampsia" = colour1)

gene_visuals <- function(df, genes) {
  for (i in genes) {
    probe <- linker_names %>% 
      filter(GENE == i) %>% 
      pull(PROBEID)

    expression_values <- df %>%
      filter(probe_id == probe) %>%
      select(-probe_id) %>%
      unlist()

    gene_and_cov <- clean_cov_data %>%
      mutate(expression = expression_values[geoID])

    ## histogram
    hist_plot <- ggplot(gene_and_cov, aes(x = expression)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = base_colour, color = "white") +
      labs(title = str_wrap(paste0(i, " Gene Expression"), width=40),
           x = "Expression Level",
           y = "Number of samples") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

    ## scatterplot
    scatter_plot <- ggplot(gene_and_cov, aes(x = sampleCollection_gestAge_wks, y = expression)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2, color = base_colour) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = colour1, fill = colour1, alpha = 0.3) +
      labs(title = str_wrap(paste0(i, " Expression vs. Gestational Age at Sample Collection"),
                    width = 40),
           x = "Gestational Age at Sample Collection (weeks)",
           y = paste0(i, " expression")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

    ## boxplot
    box_plot <- ggplot(gene_and_cov, aes(x = bmi_group, y = expression, fill = preg_preeclampsia)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.6) + # jitter adds them back in
      geom_jitter(aes(color = preg_preeclampsia), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.3),
                  alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE)+
      scale_fill_manual(values = col_palette) +
      scale_color_manual(values = col_palette)+
      labs(title = str_wrap(paste0(i, " Expression by BMI Group and Preeclampsia Status"),
                            width=40),
           x = "BMI group",
           y = paste0(i, " expression"),
           fill = "Pregnancy condition") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

    print(hist_plot)
    print(scatter_plot)
    print(box_plot)
    
    ggsave(paste0(i, "_histogram.png"),hist_plot, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(i, "_scatterplot.png"), scatter_plot, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(i, "_boxplot.png"),box_plot, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)}
}
```


```{r}
gene_visuals(clean_gene_exp, project_genes)
```

```{r}
## heatmap  
project_genes_new <- c("BARD1","ISM2", "ZPBP", "NUP188","STAB2","JAM2","FAM170A","SPECC1","MAGEF1","CALHM2")

gene_list_new <- linker_names %>%
  filter(GENE %in% project_genes_new)

# install.packages("pheatmap")
library(pheatmap)

## making the probe IDs the row names
gene_exp_rows <- clean_gene_exp %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames("probe_id")

## picking the 10 rows by name, in order of gene list and making a matrix that
## heatmap fucntion can use
heat_matrix <- as.matrix(gene_exp_rows[as.character(gene_list_new$PROBEID), ])

## swapping the probe IDs for gene names
rownames(heat_matrix) <- gene_list_new$GENE

# dim(heat_matrix)

tracking_bars <- as.data.frame(clean_cov_data[, c("preg_preeclampsia", "bmi_group")])
rownames(tracking_bars) <- clean_cov_data$geoID # row matched with sample ID
colnames(tracking_bars) <- c("Condition", "BMI group")# names for the legend

# plot colours
bar_colors <- list( Condition = c("Normal" = base_colour, "Preeclampsia" = colour1),
  `BMI group` = c("Underweight/Normal" = "#EAE3F0", "Overweight" = "#B7A6CF", "Obese" = "#6E5A92"))

heat_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4F83BC", "#FAF6F2", "#E37A55"))(25)

pheatmap(heat_matrix,
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = tracking_bars,
         annotation_colors = bar_colors,
         color = heat_colors,
         show_colnames = FALSE, # hiding the sample IDs
         fontsize = 12,
         fontsize_row = 12,
         main = "Expression of 10 Genes Across 157 Women",
         filename = "heatmap1.png",
         width = 10,height = 6)
```


```{r}
## TABLE ONE 
# head(clean_cov_data$delivery_gestAge_wks)
# head(clean_cov_data$mat_age_yrs)

# data cleaning
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data%>%
  mutate(delivery_gestAge_wks = parse_number(delivery_gestAge_wks))

clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data%>%
  mutate(mat_age_yrs = parse_number(mat_age_yrs))

summary(clean_cov_data$mat_age_yrs)

# install.packages("tableone")
library(tableone)

table_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  transmute(`Maternal age (years)` = mat_age_yrs,
            `Gestational Age at Sample Collection (weeks)` = sampleCollection_gestAge_wks,
            `Gestational Age at Delivery (weeks)` = delivery_gestAge_wks,
            `BMI group` = bmi_group,
            Condition = preg_preeclampsia)
## variables for rows
variablez <- c( "Maternal age (years)","Gestational Age at Sample Collection (weeks)",
                "Gestational Age at Delivery (weeks)","BMI group")

table1 <- CreateTableOne(vars = variablez,
                         strata = "Condition",
                         data = table_data,
                         test = FALSE) # removing p-values

table1_full <- print(table1, printToggle = FALSE)
# table1_full
write.csv(table1_full, "table1.csv")
```
```{r}
## additional visualisation - modeled from "The Office Ratings" on R-graph gallery
## finding each BMI group's average delivery age, then drawing lines to represent each woman's delivery age.

## cleaning variable
clean_cov_data <- clean_cov_data %>%
  mutate(delivery_gestAge_wks = parse_number(delivery_gestAge_wks))

# choosing variables for plot
women_data<- clean_cov_data %>%
  select(bmi_group, # separating by BMI
         condition = preg_preeclampsia, # needed for colour
         delivery_weeks = delivery_gestAge_wks) %>%
  arrange(bmi_group, condition, delivery_weeks) %>% 
  mutate(woman_number = row_number(), # counting all the women
         group_number = as.numeric(bmi_group), # making the bmi into countable groups
         x_position = woman_number + 8 * group_number) # shifting each group so there can be space

# work out each group's average and where its line starts and ends
group_avgs <- women_data%>%
  group_by(bmi_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(delivery_weeks),
            line_start = min(x_position) - 0.5,
            line_end = max(x_position) + 0.5,
            line_middle = mean(x_position),
            .groups = "drop")

## attaching the group avg to each woman's info
women_data<- women_data%>%
  left_join(group_avgs %>% select(bmi_group, mean_value), by = "bmi_group")

lollipop<- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = women_data,
               aes(x = x_position, xend = x_position, y = mean_value, yend = delivery_weeks, color = condition),
               alpha = 0.7) +
  
  geom_point(data = women_data, # each dot for one woman
             aes(x = x_position, y = delivery_weeks, color = condition), size = 1.5) +
  
  geom_segment(data = group_avgs,
               aes(x = line_start, xend = line_end, y = mean_value, yend = mean_value),
               linewidth = 1.5, color = "grey30") + # avaerage for each line
  scale_color_manual(values = col_palette, name = "Condition") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = group_avgs$line_middle,
                     labels = as.character(group_avgs$bmi_group)) +
  labs(title = "Gestational Age at Delivery by BMI Group",
       x = NULL, y = "Gestational age at delivery (weeks)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
lollipop

ggsave("lollipop.png", lollipop,width = 8,height=5)
```
